settings_yaml:
# No action flag = checks only. Every expensive operation is explicitly selected.
source_first: models/waypoint_ppo_pilot_seed61/best_model.zip
output_root: models/staged_avoidance_v3_seed61
data_root: data/staged_avoidance_v3_seed61
interface_contract: reference_preserving_v3
terminal_radius: 0.20  # rad, largest absolute joint error to fixed goal
reference_recovery: {radius: 0.30, min_distance: 0.08, improvement: 0.02}
environment: configs/ppo_dynamic_clean.yaml
release: releases/path_reference_bc_20261025
seed: 61
additional_timesteps: 10000
workers: 4
n_steps: 250
batch_size: 100
n_epochs: 3
learning_rate: 0.0001
clip_range: 0.05
target_kl: 0.005
eval_every: 5000
residual_scale: 2.0
initial_prior_gate: 0.5
action_std: 0.10  # 0.15 is a separate exploration ablation, not an automatic increase.
progress_weight: 0.25
joint_margin: 0.01
clearance_distance: 0.08
clearance_weight: 0.50
mixture: {alignment: 0.20, static: 0.30, dynamic: 0.50}
train_scenes: 64
validation_scenes: 20
train_seed_base: 800000
validation_seed_base: 900000
teacher:
  alignment_episodes: 20
  avoidance_episodes: 80
  maximum_attempts: 500
  minimum_unique_scenes: 10
  updates: 2000
  batch_size: 256
  learning_rate: 0.001
  terminal_weight: 2.0
  gate_retention_weight: 0.01
  residual_weight: 0.001
bc_gate:
  minimum_episodes: 20
  minimum_alignment_episodes: 10
  minimum_success_rate: 0.50
  maximum_collision_rate: 0.25
  minimum_alignment_success_rate: 0.90
  maximum_goal_action: 0.005
gate:
  minimum_episodes: 20
  minimum_alignment_episodes: 10
  minimum_success_rate: 0.80
  maximum_collision_rate: 0.10
  minimum_alignment_success_rate: 0.90
  consecutive_checks: 2
stages:
  - {name: one_static, count: 1, mode: static, amplitude: 0.05, speed: 0.02}
  - {name: one_dynamic, count: 1, mode: dynamic, amplitude: 0.05, speed: 0.02}
  - {name: three_dynamic, count: 3, mode: dynamic, amplitude: 0.10, speed: 0.05}
  - {name: five_dynamic_low, count: 5, mode: dynamic, amplitude: 0.10, speed: 0.05}
  - {name: five_dynamic_full, count: 5, mode: dynamic, amplitude: 0.40, speed: 0.40}
workflow: prepare -> teacher(20 alignment + 80 avoidance successes) -> BC(2000 updates) -> BC gate -> PPO(10000 steps only if gate passes) -> assessment
